scope: historical G12 source identity and CAD-property comparison only

parts.fin_centroid_inertia_basis: historical density-weighted composite; current geometric values are uniform-volume, not comparable

root_adhesive_budget.allocation_basis: Reallocate only the explicitly modeled tab, gusset-face and curved-foot bonds from the existing 6 g tab/fillet plus 2 g gusset allowance. Keep the residual for unmodeled fillets and application variation. New skin/core/cap/tip-seal/frame-gap bonds remain additional.

skin.basis: Typical production sheet data, not guaranteed minima; 0.25 mm product is 0.22 +/-0.10 mm and 0.35 kg/m2; E0/90 50.1 GPa, tensile strength 641 MPa. Single ply; compression, 45-degree, transverse and full laminate engineering constants unavailable.

core.basis: Typical density 75 kg/m3, compression modulus 97 MPa, shear modulus 30 MPa, shear strength 1.2 MPa; no hot allowables or thickness tolerance established. The 0.3 mm core tolerance is an explicit conservative study assumption.

assembly.basis: Supplier discusses bonding thin cured sheets to foam using epoxy and preparing the glossy bonding surfaces; this does not establish this root or bond strength.

layered_study.property_status: The hot reduction, adhesive stiffness, glass-cap and skin shear values are study estimates; retain the existing 45 C substrate screen. Supplier Tg/service/processing temperatures are not a new rocket temperature limit.

refreeze.geometry_comparison_limit: Old per-part STEP unavailable except fin and frame; identical volume/centroid/inertia is not proof of same shape.
refreeze.reconstruction_limit: Generic export_vehicle regenerates a homogeneous fin and omits frame post-Boolean rounded saddles; use explicit source STEP substitution and output assembly.
refreeze.motion_history: Flat servo horns/fixed-shaft and prior conflict evidence remain open; no inherited motion or strength pass.

post_run_code_hashes.scope: post-run filesystem hashes only; these were not captured before worker execution
